tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want to see my total wallet balance and each segment's balance so that I understand how much I can spend.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم موجودی کل کیف پول و هر بخش را ببینم تا بدانم چقدر می‌توانم خرج کنم.
tickets.description: The Wallet Overview must present the total of all segments at the top and a per-segment list underneath. Each segment shows its balance, a short eligibility rule line, and an icon. Values must come from GET /api/wallet and be rendered in EUR with two decimals.
tickets.descriptionFa: صفحه نمای کیف پول باید مجموع تمام بخش‌ها را در بالای صفحه و فهرست تک تک بخش‌ها را در زیر آن نمایش دهد. هر بخش شامل موجودی، توضیح کوتاه قانون و آیکون است. مقادیر باید از GET /api/wallet گرفته شده و با فرمت یورو و دو رقم اعشار نمایش داده شود.
preconditions: The API is running and seeded with the default wallet.

acceptanceCriteria.then: the element with data-testid='wallet-total' shows €220.00
four segment cards are visible with data-testids wallet-segment-cash, wallet-segment-gift, wallet-segment-cashback, wallet-segment-corporate
wallet-segment-cash shows €120.00, wallet-segment-gift shows €25.00, wallet-segment-cashback shows €15.00, wallet-segment-corporate shows €60.00

scenarios.happyPath: Navigate to /wallet; see total €220.00 and four segments at their seeded balances.
scenarios.negative: After calling POST /api/dev/reset the balances must return to the default seeded values.

expectedResults: Total balance equals the sum of segment balances.
Every segment card is rendered with its rule label.

tickets.summaryFa: موجودی‌های بخش‌های مختلف با حسابداری مجزا
tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want each wallet segment to track its own balance separately so that spending from one segment never silently affects another.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم هر بخش کیف پول موجودی خودش را داشته باشد تا خرج کردن از یک بخش روی بخش دیگر تأثیر نگذارد.
tickets.description: Each of the four segments (Cash, Gift, Cashback, Corporate) is accounted independently. Any debit against one segment must change only that segment's balance. Balances are driven by the ledger; there is no direct balance mutation outside ledger events.
tickets.descriptionFa: هر یک از چهار بخش (نقدی، هدیه، کش‌بک، سازمانی) به صورت مستقل حسابداری می‌شود. هر برداشت از یک بخش فقط موجودی همان بخش را تغییر می‌دهد. موجودی‌ها از دفتر کل محاسبه می‌شوند و هیچ تغییر مستقیمی خارج از دفتر کل رخ نمی‌دهد.
preconditions: A paid order used €40 from Cash segment only.

acceptanceCriteria.when: an order is paid using €40 from cash only
acceptanceCriteria.then: the cash segment drops to €80.00 and gift, cashback and corporate are unchanged

scenarios.happyPath: Pay a grocery €40 order fully from cash. Confirm only cash dropped to €80.
scenarios.negative: Attempting to debit a segment below zero must be rejected by the API with INSUFFICIENT_SEGMENT_BALANCE.

expectedResults: Only the debited segment balance changes.
Ledger contains exactly one debit entry on the touched segment.

tickets.userStory: As the platform, I want segment rules enforced on the server so that customers cannot pay with an ineligible segment.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان پلتفرم، می‌خواهم قوانین بخش‌ها در سمت سرور اعمال شوند تا کاربر نتواند با بخش غیرمجاز پرداخت کند.
tickets.description: Gift credit is only allowed when every order item is in the grocery or fashion category. Corporate credit is only allowed when every order item is in the office category. Cashback requires a €20.00 minimum order and may cover at most 20% of the order total. The API's POST /orders/:id/quote endpoint returns an eligibility array describing the maximum spend per source. The pay endpoint re-validates these rules and rejects invalid allocations with INELIGIBLE_SEGMENT.
tickets.descriptionFa: اعتبار هدیه فقط زمانی قابل استفاده است که تمام اقلام سفارش در دسته‌بندی مواد غذایی یا مد و پوشاک باشند. اعتبار سازمانی فقط برای اقلام لوازم اداری. کش‌بک حداقل سفارش ۲۰ یورو و حداکثر ۲۰٪ مبلغ سفارش. اندپوینت quote لیست حداکثر مجاز را برمی‌گرداند و اندپوینت pay بار دیگر اعتبارسنجی می‌کند.
preconditions: The cart contains at least one electronics item and the user opens checkout.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a cart containing an electronics item
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user tries to allocate any amount to the gift segment
acceptanceCriteria.then: the frontend disables the gift input and the API responds with INELIGIBLE_SEGMENT for gift
the quote returns cashback.maxCents = 0 with reason 'minimum order €20.00 required'
the API responds with CASHBACK_LIMIT_EXCEEDED and the frontend caps cashback at €20.00

scenarios.happyPath: Grocery+fashion order allows cash, gift, cashback (if ≥€20) and card.
scenarios.negative: Electronics order disables gift and corporate at the UI and the API rejects any such allocation.

expectedResults: Quote reflects per-segment maximum spend.
Pay endpoint rejects ineligible allocations with structured error codes.

tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want to browse products and add them to a cart with adjustable quantities.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم محصولات را مرور کرده و با مقادیر قابل تنظیم به سبد خرید اضافه کنم.
tickets.description: The catalog screen lists products from GET /api/products with a category filter. The cart screen shows each line item with +/- buttons and a running subtotal. Shipping is a fixed €2.00. All currency rendering uses two decimals.
tickets.descriptionFa: صفحه فروشگاه محصولات را از GET /api/products با فیلتر دسته‌بندی نمایش می‌دهد. صفحه سبد خرید اقلام را با دکمه‌های + / - و جمع جاری نشان می‌دهد. هزینه ارسال ثابت ۲ یورو است.
preconditions: The API is seeded with at least one product per category.

acceptanceCriteria.when: the user clicks 'add' on Fresh Bananas
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Cart tab badge increments to 1 and the cart contains Fresh Bananas with quantity 1

acceptanceCriteria.given: the cart has one Fresh Bananas line
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user clicks the + button on that line
acceptanceCriteria.then: quantity becomes 2 and the subtotal updates to 2 × unit price
the line is removed

scenarios.happyPath: Browse → add items from different categories → open cart and confirm subtotal and shipping.
scenarios.negative: Removing all items empties the cart and the Checkout button becomes disabled.

expectedResults: Category filter restricts the visible product list.
Cart totals equal Σ(unitPrice × qty) + €2 shipping.

tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want to submit my cart to create an order so that I can proceed to pay.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم سبد خرید خود را ثبت کنم تا سفارش ایجاد شده و پرداخت را آغاز کنم.
tickets.description: POST /api/orders accepts an items array of { productId, quantity }. The server resolves prices, computes items total + shipping, assigns an id like ORD-10001, and returns an order in status 'pending_payment'. The client navigates to /checkout/:id.
tickets.descriptionFa: POST /api/orders آرایه‌ای از { productId, quantity } می‌پذیرد. سرور قیمت‌ها را حل می‌کند، جمع اقلام و هزینه ارسال را محاسبه می‌کند، یک شناسه مانند ORD-10001 اختصاص می‌دهد و سفارش را با وضعیت 'pending_payment' بازمی‌گرداند.
preconditions: The cart has at least one item.

acceptanceCriteria.then: the app navigates to /checkout/<id>, the server returns status 'pending_payment' and the totals match the cart

scenarios.happyPath: Submit a cart with 3 items, land on /checkout with the right total.
scenarios.negative: Submitting an empty cart is rejected with EMPTY_CART.

expectedResults: An Order record exists and is retrievable at GET /api/orders/:id.
Order id follows ORD- prefix convention.

tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want to split an order across wallet segments and a card so that I can mix funds.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم سفارش را بین بخش‌های کیف پول و کارت تقسیم کنم تا بتوانم از چند منبع پرداخت کنم.
tickets.description: Checkout screen shows an allocation row per source: segments that are eligible are enabled with a numeric input bounded by min(eligibility.maxCents, segment.balance). Card has no upper cap. A live 'Allocated' footer shows Σ allocations and turns green when it equals the total.
tickets.descriptionFa: صفحه پرداخت برای هر منبع یک ردیف تخصیص نمایش می‌دهد: بخش‌های واجد شرایط با مقدار عددی محدود به min(حداکثر مجاز، موجودی بخش) فعال هستند. کارت سقف ندارد. پاورقی 'تخصیص یافته' مجموع را نشان می‌دهد و در صورت برابری با مبلغ کل سبز می‌شود.
preconditions: An order is in pending_payment status.

acceptanceCriteria.when: the user sets cash=40, gift=20, cashback=10, card=30
acceptanceCriteria.then: the allocated footer equals €100.00 and the Finalize Payment button is enabled

acceptanceCriteria.when: the sum of allocations is less than €100.00
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Finalize Payment button is disabled and the footer shows a remaining amount

scenarios.happyPath: Split 40/20/10/30 across cash/gift/cashback/card for a €100 grocery order.
scenarios.negative: Entering cash=130 is clamped to the cash segment's balance of €120.

expectedResults: Allocation inputs respect eligibility maxCents.
Finalize Payment enabled only when Σ allocations == total.

tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want a successful multi-source payment to debit each source atomically so that my order is paid in one go.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم پرداخت موفق چندمنبعی به صورت یکپارچه از هر منبع کسر شود تا سفارش به یکباره پرداخت گردد.
tickets.description: POST /api/orders/:id/pay with valid allocations that sum to the total and gatewayMode='success' commits all wallet reservations and marks the order 'paid'. The Payment Result screen shows a success state with the breakdown per source and order id.
tickets.descriptionFa: POST /api/orders/:id/pay با تخصیص‌های معتبر و gatewayMode='success' تمام رزروهای کیف پول را کامیت کرده و سفارش را 'paid' می‌کند. صفحه نتیجه پرداخت وضعیت موفق را با تفکیک به ازای هر منبع و شناسه سفارش نمایش می‌دهد.
preconditions: A grocery order ORD-X with total €100.00 and allocations 40/20/10/30 is ready.
QA gateway mode is set to success.

acceptanceCriteria.then: the UI navigates to /payment-result/:id showing a success state and 'Paid €100.00'
cash=80.00, gift=5.00, cashback=5.00, corporate=60.00 and total=150.00

scenarios.happyPath: Pay 40/20/10/30 and land on the success screen with the correct breakdown.
scenarios.negative: If the committed order is re-queried, its status is 'paid' and it has exactly one committed payment attempt.

expectedResults: Order status is 'paid'.
Wallet segments reflect the debits.
Ledger contains one commit entry per source.

tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want a failed card charge to fully restore my wallet balances so that no funds are lost on a failed payment.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم شکست پرداخت کارت موجودی کیف پول را به حالت اولیه بازگرداند تا هیچ وجهی از دست نرود.
tickets.description: When gatewayMode='card_declined' or 'network_error', wallet reservations are reversed and the order is marked 'failed'. The UI shows a failure state with a 'Retry Payment' action that returns to the allocation screen with the previous allocations prefilled.
tickets.descriptionFa: هنگامی که gatewayMode برابر 'card_declined' یا 'network_error' باشد، رزروهای کیف پول برگردانده شده و سفارش به 'failed' تغییر می‌کند. UI وضعیت ناموفق را با گزینه 'تلاش مجدد' نمایش می‌دهد.
preconditions: A grocery order with allocations and gatewayMode='card_declined'.

acceptanceCriteria.then: the UI shows 'Payment failed' and the wallet returns to its pre-attempt balances
each wallet source has one reservation entry and one matching reversal entry for the same amount

scenarios.happyPath: Retry with gatewayMode=success completes the order correctly.
scenarios.negative: Gateway network_error produces the same compensation outcome.

expectedResults: Order status is 'failed'.
Wallet balances equal their pre-attempt values.
A matching reversal entry exists for every reservation.

tickets.userStory: As the platform, I want duplicate payment requests with the same idempotency key to be deduplicated so that a user is never charged twice.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان پلتفرم، می‌خواهم درخواست‌های تکراری پرداخت با همان کلید بی‌قراردادی حذف شوند تا کاربر دو بار شارژ نشود.
tickets.description: POST /api/orders/:id/pay requires an idempotencyKey. Replays with the same key on the same order return the original PaymentAttempt untouched. Replays with the same key but a conflicting payload return 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Paid orders reject any new attempt with ORDER_ALREADY_PAID.
tickets.descriptionFa: POST /api/orders/:id/pay به idempotencyKey نیاز دارد. درخواست تکراری با همان کلید و بار یکسان همان PaymentAttempt اولیه را برمی‌گرداند؛ با بار متفاوت 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. سفارش پرداخت‌شده هر درخواست جدیدی را با ORDER_ALREADY_PAID رد می‌کند.
preconditions: A paid order with idempotencyKey K1.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the paid order and the same allocations
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/orders/:id/pay is called again with K1
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response reuses the original PaymentAttempt and wallet balances are unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/orders/:id/pay is called again with a new idempotency key
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API responds with ORDER_ALREADY_PAID

acceptanceCriteria.when: the payload differs from the original
acceptanceCriteria.then: the API responds with IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT

scenarios.happyPath: Replay with the same key — no additional debit.
scenarios.negative: Attempting a new payment on a paid order is rejected.

expectedResults: Only one committed PaymentAttempt per order.
Idempotent replays are safe and deterministic.

tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want to fully refund a paid order so that my wallet segments are credited back and the card refund is recorded.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم یک سفارش پرداخت‌شده را به طور کامل بازگردانم تا بخش‌های کیف پول دوباره شارژ شده و بازگشت کارت ثبت شود.
tickets.description: POST /api/orders/:id/refund with a fresh idempotencyKey reverses every wallet allocation back to its original segment and records a card refund entry. Order status becomes 'refunded'. Repeating the refund is a no-op idempotent response.
tickets.descriptionFa: POST /api/orders/:id/refund با کلید بی‌قراردادی جدید تمام تخصیص‌های کیف پول را به بخش اصلی بازمی‌گرداند و بازپرداخت کارت را ثبت می‌کند. وضعیت سفارش 'refunded' می‌شود. تکرار یک no-op idempotent است.
preconditions: A paid order ORD-X with the 40/20/10/30 breakdown.

acceptanceCriteria.when: the user clicks the Refund button on /orders/:id
acceptanceCriteria.then: the wallet returns to the pre-payment balances and the order status becomes 'refunded'
the API returns a NOT_REFUNDABLE error and the UI disables the Refund button

scenarios.happyPath: Refund a €100 order and see balances restored to the seeded defaults.
scenarios.negative: Refund attempts on a non-paid order are rejected with NOT_REFUNDABLE.

expectedResults: Wallet segments return to pre-payment balances.
Ledger contains a credit entry per source and a card refund entry.

tickets.userStory: As an operator, I want to inspect the full ledger with filters so that I can trace balance changes to events.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان اپراتور، می‌خواهم دفتر کل را با فیلتر مشاهده کنم تا بتوانم تغییرات موجودی را به رویدادها ردگیری کنم.
tickets.description: GET /api/ledger returns the full event stream sorted by createdAt desc. The UI exposes 'All / Payments / Refunds' filters and shows: timestamp, order id, source, amount with +/− sign and state badge. Each row lists its reason code when present.
tickets.descriptionFa: GET /api/ledger جریان کامل رویدادها را به ترتیب نزولی زمان برمی‌گرداند. UI فیلترهای «همه / پرداخت‌ها / بازگشت‌ها» را ارائه می‌دهد و هر ردیف شامل زمان، شناسه سفارش، منبع، مبلغ با علامت +/− و وضعیت است.
preconditions: At least one payment and one refund exist.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful pay and a successful refund
acceptanceCriteria.then: payment entries appear with negative amounts and refund entries with positive amounts

acceptanceCriteria.when: the user clicks the Refunds filter
acceptanceCriteria.then: only refund entries remain visible

scenarios.happyPath: Filter between All/Payments/Refunds and see row counts update accordingly.

expectedResults: Ledger entry count equals payment debits + refund credits + their reversals if any.
No balance change exists without a corresponding ledger entry.

tickets.userStory: As a shopper, I want the app to install and show a clear offline state so that I do not attempt payments without connectivity.
tickets.userStoryFa: به عنوان یک خریدار، می‌خواهم اپلیکیشن قابل نصب باشد و در حالت آفلاین به وضوح نمایش داده شود تا پرداخت بدون اتصال انجام نشود.
tickets.description: The app ships a web manifest with 192 and 512 icons and a service worker that caches the app shell. When offline, a banner with data-testid='offline-banner' appears and the Finalize Payment button is disabled with a tooltip explaining why.
tickets.descriptionFa: اپلیکیشن دارای manifest با آیکون‌های ۱۹۲ و ۵۱۲ و سرویس ورکر برای کش کردن پوسته است. در حالت آفلاین بنر با data-testid='offline-banner' ظاهر می‌شود و دکمه پرداخت نهایی غیرفعال می‌گردد.
preconditions: The web app is served and the service worker is registered.

acceptanceCriteria.then: the offline-banner element becomes visible and the Finalize Payment button is disabled
it includes name='SegmentPay', 192 and 512 icons, and display='standalone'

scenarios.happyPath: Install the PWA, go offline, see the banner, go online, see the banner disappear.
scenarios.negative: Offline payment attempts must not be submitted to the API.

expectedResults: Manifest and service worker registered.
Offline banner reacts to navigator.onLine and online/offline events.
